notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (B2B support platform) exploring Redwood for customer-facing chat agents. Primary ask: hosted API for quick rollout, then predictable transition to Dedicated once traffic stabilizes. Focus on streaming + tool calling (calendar lookup, account lookup).

Key SLOs / requirements:
- First-token latency SLO: <=1.5s for typical sessions (95th pct under 1.5s).
- Streaming support required (live agent handoff, progressive response).
- Tool calling for structured actions (ticket update, escalate, triage).
- Routing: prefer region us-east-1; fallbacks to eu-west on failover.
- Audit logs + retention: 12 months, integration with internal SIEM via Kinesis.

POC / Technical notes:
- Completed initial hosted demo 2026-03-01 (see Fireflies FF-20260301-HeliosRelay-demo). AE + SE ran end-to-end: chat streaming, tool call to stub ticket API, simulated 50 concurrent agents.
- SE notes: streaming latency good under low load (~400ms first-token) but 95th increases to ~1.6-1.8s under 100 concurrent sessions in us-east-1 (no batching). Need to test Redwood Optimize suggestions: KV caching, prefix cache, and batching cap.
- Requested: short POC plan to validate 95th pct <1.5s at expected peak (120 concurrent chat sessions with streaming + toolcalls).
- Model prefs: prefer open models (gpt-style open checkpoint) with verified latency profile; would accept smaller fallback for cost-sensitive routes. Interested in quantized variants for Dedicated.

Commercial / Procurement:
- Price sensitivity: mid-market budget; AR range $75k-$200k. Want clear headroom for bursts (weekend incidents).
- Interested in Dedicated pricing once POC shows stable latencies; wants committed capacity option with burst buffer.

Stakeholders & Quotes:
- CTO (Maya Chen): "We need predictable latency — live support agents cannot wait. If first token slips past 1.5s at scale, service UX breaks."
- Head of Product (Liam Ortiz): wants developer-friendly SDKs and quick token-level cost breakdowns.

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-02-15: Lead created from demo request form. (AE assigned Jordan Reyes)
- 2026-02-22: Intro call + discovery (Priya joined) — mapped use cases and SLOs.
- 2026-03-01: Hosted demo + initial streaming run (fireflies link).
- 2026-03-05: Follow-up technical deep-dive with SE (requested POC plan).
- 2026-03-08: Procurement team sent security questionnaire (drive link).

Open questions / blockers to resolve:
- Legal: data residency clause for EU customers (some customers require EU-only storage).
- Engineering: need Redwood to validate 95th <1.5s under 120 concurrent streaming sessions with toolcalls; ask Redwood to provide test harness or guidance.
- Pricing: confirm Dedicated commit tiers and burst pricing mechanics.

Next steps (short):
